techs.name: Agrarian Works
techs.description: Bread first; empires can quarrel about philosophy after supper. Unlocks the Farmstead (+2 FOOD slots on farm tiles) and adds +1 FOOD slot on every owned fish tile.

techs.name: Merchant Charters
techs.description: Someone must be licensed to overcharge for nails.

techs.name: Titanium-Clad Masonry
techs.description: Stone is the first polite way of saying no. Reveals Titanium and unlocks the Titanium Weapons Factory: an uncapped Titanium sink that arms your empire with heavier defense and titanium-forged siege strength, clustered strongest where you build many in one connected industrial region.

techs.name: Rigging Works
techs.description: Straps, harnesses, and portable frames turn baggage into warfare. Reveals Umbrite and unlocks the Umbrite Weapons Factory: an uncapped Umbrite sink that arms your empire for the offensive, clustered strongest where you build many in one connected industrial region.

techs.name: Supply Directorate
techs.description: Armies march on paperwork, then complain about the rations.

techs.name: Aetheric Resonance
techs.description: A good lattice turns raw crystal from a rock into an argument. Reveals Crystal, and stands up an Observatory and Aether Condenser.

techs.name: Deep Shaft Mining
techs.description: If the ground objects, dig deeper until it apologizes.

techs.name: Hydraulic Works
techs.description: Canals are what happen when paranoia meets agriculture. Unlocks the Waterworks: every Farmstead within 10 tiles gains +2 FOOD slots.

techs.name: Kiln Craft
techs.description: Clay keeps better secrets than wood, especially from rats. The kiln now hums with a burst of new hands.

techs.name: Artisan Workshops
techs.description: Once every craft has a foreman, even raw ore becomes industry.

techs.name: Double-Entry Ledgers
techs.description: Accountants are how empires weaponize boredom.

techs.name: Minting Works
techs.description: Once the crown stamps metal, every mintworks starts behaving like law.

techs.name: Reinforced Plating
techs.description: Unlocks Titanium Bastion upgrades for existing Forts and keeps +10% settled defense.

techs.name: Siege Engineering
techs.description: Unlocks Siege Tower upgrades for existing Siege Outposts.

techs.name: Muster Discipline
techs.description: A staging tile stops being a rumor once it has a rota.

techs.name: Alchemical Forges
techs.description: The kettle hisses, the glass clouds, and ore starts behaving like a respectable science.

techs.name: Steam-Driven Extraction
techs.description: The earth gives more when leaned on with proper machinery.

techs.name: Bureaucratic Reform
techs.description: Eventually every empire invents offices and regrets it immediately.

techs.name: Standing Legion
techs.description: Unlocks Dread Tower upgrades for existing Siege Towers.

techs.name: Steel Foundries
techs.description: Unlocks Thunder Bastion upgrades for existing Titanium Bastions.

techs.name: Muster Command
techs.description: A second staging tile means an army can gather while another marches.

techs.name: Census Bureau
techs.description: Once the state can count everyone, it begins developing opinions.

techs.name: Rail & Wire Networks
techs.description: Once the rails arrive, distance becomes an accounting problem.

techs.name: Conveyor Networks
techs.description: One line of belts, and a hundred hands stop tripping over each other.

techs.name: The Remade Concordat
techs.description: A guild that keeps the manpower ledgers even when nobody's marching.

techs.name: Demographic Registry
techs.description: Once the ledgers know exactly who you have, the empire learns to make more of them.

techs.name: Grand Levy Doctrine
techs.description: The whole reserve, called up at once, whether the reserve likes it or not.

techs.name: Survey Sweep
techs.description: Men with chains and notebooks are often more dangerous than cavalry.

techs.name: Cipher Craft
techs.description: Spies improve dramatically once given clerks and a budget.

techs.name: Covert Logistics
techs.description: Wheels, manifests, and shouting make an empire move faster than dignity should allow.

techs.name: Harbor Engineering
techs.description: Brass winches and humming pylons make a port look properly expensive.

techs.name: Terrain Shaping
techs.description: Once enough crystal is involved, even geography becomes negotiable.

techs.name: Beacon Network
techs.description: Taller beacons mean fewer surprises and better excuses.

techs.name: Celestial Navigation
techs.description: The sea becomes considerably less final once the bridge crews stop fearing electricity.

techs.name: Sky Vessel Engineering
techs.description: Once the harbor learns to levitate, the neighbors stop sleeping soundly.

techs.name: Resonance Detection
techs.description: The air itself starts reporting suspicious activity.

techs.name: Aether-Infused Synthesis
techs.description: At full pressure the retort stops accepting the world's categories and starts drafting better ones.

techs.name: Grand Bazaars
techs.description: If every mintworks in the world hates you, the project is functioning correctly.

techs.name: Worldbreaker Doctrine
techs.description: Why capture a district gracefully when you can simply remove it from geology? Fires the moment the cannon is built.

techs.name: Aegis Doctrine
techs.description: Nothing says enlightened government like a city under glass.

techs.name: Astral Doctrine
techs.description: If the heavens will not visit the empire, the empire will launch a drydock at them.
